memo.justification: We compared logistic regression, random forest, histogram gradient boosting, LightGBM and a small neural net under the same tuning budget, without using call duration (only known after the call). On held-out later clients the neural net was only +0.003 AUC above logistic, and the 95% interval for that gap includes zero, so the gain is not clearly real. Deploy the simpler logistic model. Expect about 1.61x more subscribers in the top 10% of the ranked list than by calling at random. Main risk: subscription rates rose sharply over time, so the next campaign may differ from the past.
